definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of arthro-series glucosylceramides that begins with the synthesis of a tetrasaccharide core GalNAc-beta-1,4-GlcNAc-beta-1,3-Man-beta-1,4Glc-ceramide. This core can be further elongated with the sequential addition of various carbohydrate units.
label: arthro-series glucosylceramide biosynthetic process
